class.name: NetwDespawnOpts
class.description: The defaults are safe to use, so passing no options is fine. [codeblock] var opts := NetwDespawnOpts.create(&"killed") opts.linger = true NetwEntity.of(self).despawn(opts) [/codeblock]

method.name: create
method.description: Returns options with [param reason] and every other option at its default.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], [method Node.queue_free] is deferred so a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] does not push state from a node that is already freed.

When [code]true[/code], the entity's row is saved after the node leaves the tree. The despawn does not wait for the save, await [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save] before despawning if you need it stored.
When [code]true[/code], the entity is deactivated now but freed only after [member linger_seconds], so a late shot can still hit where it was.
Seconds a lingering entity can still be rewound before it is freed. Ignored unless [member linger] is [code]true[/code].
Passed to [signal NetwEntity.despawning] so a game can react to the cause, such as [code]&"peer_disconnected"[/code], [code]&"killed"[/code] or [code]&"timeout"[/code].
